subject: NexusAI renewal — Q3 usage health, latency snapshot, and term proposal
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NexusAI renewal — Q3 usage health, latency snapshot, and term proposal

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the time last week. I pulled together a short health snapshot and a recommended term tweak that should give NexusAI predictable economics while buying headroom for your growing embedding and agent workloads. Attached: the Q3 token report and a short latency / sequence-length breakdown. Key highlights below.

1) Usage mix shift (month-over-month):
   - Chat prompt tokens down ~12% but chat generation tokens up ~26% (more assistant responses per session).
   - Embedding units up ~48% driven by vector reindexing and semantic search refresh cadence.

2) Cost drivers and ops impact:
   - Embedding-heavy workflows are increasing unit cost sensitivity; at current run-rate, projected monthly spend grows ~38% over current commit.
   - Latency: median p50 token latency is stable, but p95 increased from 340ms to 560ms during peak due to longer average sequence lengths in batch jobs (see latency_seqlen_breakdown.png).

3) ROI and proposed mitigations (quick math):
   - Current committed spend: $120k/month.
   - Forecast run-rate (next 90d): $165k/month without term change.
   - Recommended: shift to a tiered commit model — baseline commit $135k/mo + burst credits pool and a capped overage rate for embeddings. Estimated effective price per 1M embedding units reduces by ~14% when committing to 12 months.

Action items I recommend for calendar sync:
- Quick 30m to walk the attached breakdown and confirm whether Nexus wants burst credits or higher baseline commit (I propose Tue or Wed mornings).
- If we agree on baseline + burst, I’ll circulate a short updated term sheet (2-pager) for legal.

If helpful, Marissa can run a 14-day pilot on Dedicated-equivalent routing for your largest embedding job (to show latency and cost delta).

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: nexus_q3_token_report.pdf (summary), latency_seqlen_breakdown.png
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexusai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexusai.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NexusAI renewal — Q3 usage health, latency snapshot, and term proposal

Thanks Priyom — useful summary. Quick clarifying items from our side: 

- Embeddings growth is real — we're running weekly re-indexes to support new feature launches. We expected cost to go up, but the jump you show is steeper than we modeled.
- Latency spike: that p95 is from a scheduled batch (long sequence, >4k tokens) we started for internal analytics last month — might be skewing the numbers. Can you separate the ‘live inference’ traffic from scheduled batch jobs?

We are open to a baseline increase but want two things: (1) tighter predictability for embedding unit pricing, and (2) a short performance SLA for live inference paths. If you can demo the Dedicated-equivalent pilot and show p95 under 350ms for live traffic, we can consider the 12-month baseline commit.

We’re available Wed 10am PT for a call.

—Laura
VP Product, NexusAI
laura.chen@nexusai.com

Priyom —

Couple internal asks before the call with Nexus: 
- Separate the Q3 report into two buckets: (A) live API traffic (customer-facing inference) and (B) scheduled/analytics batch jobs. Laura flagged that the long-batch jobs may be inflating p95. If we can show the p95 for (A) is within SLA, we have leverage on price.
- Prepare a short pilot plan for Dedicated-equivalent routing: goals, success metrics (p95 < 350ms, 10% cost delta target), duration (14 days), and rollback. Keep it concise — one slide and a one-paragraph legal bullet.
- Pricing: model the baseline $135k/mo vs $150k/mo with different burst-credit pools (10% and 20% of baseline). Show net effective embedding unit price at projected run-rate.

I’ll join the call and handle legal/terms questions. Sean — please have the ops engineer on standby in case they ask about kernel/quantization tradeoffs.

Marissa
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexusai.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: NexusAI renewal — follow-up, pilot plan, and updated term sheet (attached)

Hi Laura / Samir —

Appreciate the quick reply and the availability for Wed. Per Marissa's prep notes, we separated live vs batch traffic and updated the Q3 report (see attached nexus_q3_token_report.pdf). Short summary of updates: 

- Live inference (customer-facing): p95 tokens are at ~320ms during peak (measured across production endpoints, excluding scheduled analytics). That meets your SLA ask for live paths.
- Batch analytics: large seq-length jobs drive p95 to the higher numbers; we'll recommend isolating those through routing policies or running on a different capacity tier to avoid impacting live SLAs.
- Pilot plan (attached) — 14 days, dedicated routing for the top 3 embedding pipelines, success criteria: p95_live <= 350ms, cost delta <= +12% vs current. If we hit both, Nexus qualifies for the proposed tiered commit pricing.

Attached also is the updated term sheet (proposed-term-sheet-NX-2026-v2.pdf) with: 
- Baseline options: $135k/mo (12 months) or $150k/mo (12 months) with 10% burst credits.
- Overages: capped embedding overage at 1.2x list rate for burst usage.
- Pilot credits: 2 weeks of burst credits and a dedicated routing trial at no charge for the pilot window.

Next steps:
1) Confirm you want us to run the 14-day pilot (we can start as soon as next Monday).
2) Legal review of the 2-pager — if Nexus signs the baseline option, we'll prep the formal SOW.

Laura — can you confirm by EOD Monday if pilot start-next-week works? If not, we’ll propose alternate start dates.

Thanks and talk soon,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
